VERSION 3.26.0.68
VERSION 3.27.x.x

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/gestures/global/qml/GesturesWindow.qml
    TRAVERSE BaseView > Item:contentItem
        REMOVE TouchAreaSwipeFilter[.objectName="global-swipe-from-top"]
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    IMPORT xofm.libs.gestures 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE BEFORE Loader#searchLoader
        INSERT {
            property alias appLoadView: _appLoadView
            required property var apploadVKB
            required property var apploadWindowParent
        }

        LOCATE AFTER Loader#searchLoader
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: _appLoadView
                anchors.fill: parent
                visible: false
                active: true
                source: "qrc:/appload/qml/appload.qml"

                onLoaded: {
                    _appLoadView.item.absoluteRoot = apploadWindowParent;
                    _appLoadView.item.virtualKeyboardRef = apploadVKB;
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: _appLoadView.item

                function onRequestClose() {
                    _appLoadView.visible = false;
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE Background
        TRAVERSE ?#navigator
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT {
                apploadVKB: _apploadVirtualKeyboard
                apploadWindowParent: windowParent
            }
        END TRAVERSE
        LOCATE BEFORE Epaper.ScreenModeItem
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: windowParent
                anchors.fill: parent
            }
            Loader {
                id: _apploadVirtualKeyboard

                property var layout: null
                property var config: null
                width: parent.width
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                active: false
                visible: active
                source: "qrc:/appload/qml/virtualKeyboard/Keyboard.qml"

                onLoaded: () => {
                    console.log("Rebuild keyboard data: ", _apploadVirtualKeyboard.layout, _apploadVirtualKeyboard.config);
                    _apploadVirtualKeyboard.item.rebuildKeyboard(_apploadVirtualKeyboard.layout, _apploadVirtualKeyboard.config);
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#integrationsHandler
        INSERT {
            SidebarFilterItem {
                id: openAppLoad
                objectName: "openAppLoad"
                title: qsTr("AppLoad")
                iconSource: "qrc:/appload/icons/appload"
                active: false
                enabled: true
                onClicked: {
                    activate();
                    root.resetFocusIndex();
                }
                Layout.preferredHeight: Values.navigatorSidebarItemHeight
                Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
                navigationHandler: root

                function activate() {
                    toggle();
                    navigator.appLoadView.visible = true;
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root
        REBUILD navigationModel
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM \integrations\ INSERT STREAM \, openAppLoad\
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


; Reach within the appload files themselves:
AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
    IMPORT xofm.libs.gestures 1.0
    IMPORT xofm.libs.devicescreen 1.0
    IMPORT common 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        TRAVERSE Rectangle#mainWindowView
            REPLACE MouseArea#qmldiffEventBlocker WITH {
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                }
                TouchArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    TouchAreaSwipeFilter {
                        objectName: "close-appload-application"
                        direction: Qt.point(0, 1)
                        area: Qt.rect(0, 0, parent.width, Values.pixelsPerCm)
                        enabled: !coord.disableGestures
                        onTriggered: swipeFromTheTop()
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
        REMOVE Button#qmldiffReplaceMeButton
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
    IMPORT xofm.libs.ghostbuster 1.0
    IMPORT xofm.libs.epaper 1.0 Epaper
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Rectangle > FBController
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Epaper.ScreenModeItem {
                anchors.fill: parent
                visible: !root.minimized && windowCanvas.active
                objectName: "appload-window"
                mode: [
                    Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Pen,
                    Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Mono,
                    Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Animation,
                    Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Content,
                    Epaper.ScreenModeItem.UI,
                ][windowCanvas.refreshMode]
            }

            onRequestFullRefresh: () => {
                ghostBuster.forceClearNow("5-finger gesture");
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/net/asivery/ApploadUtils/DisplayMethodArea.qml
    IMPORT xofm.libs.epaper 1.0 Epaper
    REDEFINE Item
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        REPLACE { Item } WITH { Epaper.ScreenModeItem }
    END REDEFINE

    LOCATE BEFORE ALL
    TRAVERSE Epaper.ScreenModeItem
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            mode: [
                Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Pen,
                Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Mono,
                Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Animation,
                Epaper.ScreenModeItem.UI,
                Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Content
            ][displayMethod]
        }
        REMOVE onDisplayMethodChanged
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
